name: acme-divi-modules
description: Divi 5 modules reproducing the Acme page designs.

scripts.start: npm run build:json && cross-env NODE_ENV=development webpack -w --config webpack.config.js --progress
scripts.build: npm run build:json && cross-env NODE_ENV=production webpack --config webpack.config.js --progress && npm run build:preview && npm run build:layout
